variants.name: HARP full
variants.hypothesis: Full hardware-aware GAT policy with hard safety and adaptive SLA/migration penalties.

variants.name: HARP w/o GAT
variants.hypothesis: Topology encoder contribution: replace GAT with a parameter-matched flat MLP policy.

variants.name: HARP w/o hard masking
variants.hypothesis: Safety masking contribution: allow policy sampling over unsafe actions, then rely on admission rejection.

variants.name: HARP w/o mask + unchecked admission
variants.hypothesis: Two-layer safety contribution: allow unmasked policy outputs to bypass MSD admission validation.

variants.name: HARP with soft MSD penalty
variants.hypothesis: Hard constraint versus reward penalty: allow MSD-unsafe admissions and penalize them softly.

variants.name: Soft MSD + runtime admission
variants.hypothesis: Evaluate the soft-MSD-trained, unmasked policy with the independent MSD admission check restored.

variants.name: HARP w/o adaptive penalty
variants.hypothesis: SLA/migration penalty contribution: disable adaptive SLA, switching, and evacuation penalties.
